scripts.deploy:all: npm run generate:wrangler && for i in {0..24}; do echo "Deploying shard$i"; npx wrangler deploy -c generated-wrangler/wrangler.shard$i.jsonc; done
scripts.deploy:local-ai: npm run check:local-ai-config && for i in {0..24}; do echo "Deploying local-AI shard$i"; npx wrangler deploy -c generated-wrangler/wrangler.shard$i.jsonc; done
